lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized in roughly parallel vertical columns along the lateral flank, with a higher spatial frequency in the anterior region relative to the posterior visible section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal side and low-luminance shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, significantly distinct in scale from the primary flank constellations.
